{"code": "def rotate_to_top(state, side):
    new_state = state.copy()
    if side == 'right':
        new_state['top'] = state['right']
        new_state['bottom'] = state['left']
        new_state['left'] = state['top']
        new_state['right'] = state['bottom']
    elif side == 'left':
        new_state['top'] = state['left']
        new_state['bottom'] = state['right']
        new_state['right'] = state['top']
        new_state['left'] = state['bottom']
    elif side == 'front':
        new_state['top'] = state['front']
        new_state['bottom'] = state['back']
        new_state['back'] = state['top']
        new_state['front'] = state['bottom']
    elif side == 'back':
        new_state['top'] = state['back']
        new_state['bottom'] = state['front']
        new_state['front'] = state['top']
        new_state['back'] = state['bottom']
    elif side == 'bottom':
        # 180 degree rotation around left-right axis
        new_state['top'] = state['bottom']
        new_state['bottom'] = state['top']
        new_state['front'] = state['back']
        new_state['back'] = state['front']
    return new_state
